title: Best violin and guitar players
summary: He names the best violinist and guitarist, including Johnny St. Cyr, and they discuss Lorenzo Staulz.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: I knew him very well. I made some records of him before he died. And dead 10 years will be this year. I was going to ask about some of the best musicians you ever heard on the different instruments. We might start with violin. Who was the best violin player down, or were there two or three of the best ones? Who were your favorites that you heard in New Orleans? You liked that.
I never got to hear him or know him. Was he left-handed?
No, sir. John Robichaud was left-handed. Robichaud was left-handed.
Who was the best guitar player, or were there several that you liked? Johnny Sincere. You like Johnny Sincere. I do too very much.
The best I may. Good, my turn.
Oh, but do you know how his name is spelled? I've never found anybody knows exactly how his name is, his last name, Lorenzo. S-T-A-U-L. Lorenzo Stahl. S-T-A-U-L. Yes, sir.
